sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接听了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空探索的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 它们可能每年都是联盟里最强的队伍。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，获取nytimes.com/subscribe的特别优惠。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Michael.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是迈克尔。

sentences.en: Today we have something really special for you.
sentences.zh: 今天我们为你准备了一些非常特别的内容。

sentences.en: A blissful break from the news.
sentences.zh: 一段远离新闻的幸福休憩时光。

sentences.en: It's a new series from NYT Audio called Animal.
sentences.zh: 这是《纽约时报》音频频道推出的新系列，名为《动物》。

sentences.en: My colleague Sam Anderson from The Times Magazine traveled the world to have encounters with animals.
sentences.zh: 我的同事，来自《时报》杂志的萨姆·安德森环游世界，去与动物们邂逅。

sentences.en: Not to claim them or to tame them, but just to appreciate them.
sentences.zh: 不是为了占有或驯服它们，而仅仅是为了欣赏它们。

sentences.en: Each episode is a journey to get closer to a creature that Sam loves.
sentences.zh: 每一集都是一段旅程，让我们更接近萨姆所钟爱的生物。

sentences.en: For the next six weeks, we'll be running this limited series every Sunday here on the Daily Feed.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的六周里，我们每周日都会在“每日推送”节目中播出这个限定系列。

sentences.en: But if you want to hear all the episodes right now, you can search for it wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 但如果你想现在就收听所有剧集，可以在你获取播客的任何地方搜索它。

sentences.en: Today, episode one.
sentences.zh: 今天，第一集。

sentences.en: Hope you like it.
sentences.zh: 希望你喜欢。

sentences.en: Let me tell you a story about a hole.
sentences.zh: 让我给你讲一个关于洞的故事。

sentences.en: A big, gaping black hole in the floor of my house.
sentences.zh: 我家地板上有一个巨大的、张着嘴的黑洞。

sentences.en: Upstairs.
sentences.zh: 在楼上。

sentences.en: From the time when I climbed up on a ladder to fix something in my daughter's room.
sentences.zh: 那是当时我爬上梯子去修女儿房间里的东西时留下的。

sentences.en: And underneath me, a floorboard cracked.
sentences.zh: 我脚下的地板裂开了。

sentences.en: It opened up this freaky looking chasm, about the size of a burrito.
sentences.zh: 它裂开了一个看起来很诡异的深渊，大约有一个墨西哥卷饼那么大。

sentences.en: But like, a big burrito.
sentences.zh: 不过，是个大卷饼。

sentences.en: A burrito stuffed with pure darkness.
sentences.zh: 一个塞满了纯粹黑暗的卷饼。

sentences.en: I'm honestly scared of this hole.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我很怕这个洞。

sentences.en: And I was supposed to fix it before something bad happened.
sentences.zh: 我本该在坏事发生前把它修好的。

sentences.en: But I kept putting it off.
sentences.zh: 但我一直拖着没修。

sentences.en: And then, something bad happened.
sentences.zh: 然后，坏事就发生了。

sentences.en: What happened was, our daughter's hamster, Mango, escaped from her cage.
sentences.zh: 发生的事情是，我们女儿的仓鼠“芒果”从笼子里逃跑了。

sentences.en: And she didn't just climb under a blanket or hide in a corner.
sentences.zh: 它不只是钻进毯子下面或躲在角落里。

sentences.en: She went down into the hole.
sentences.zh: 它钻进了那个洞里。

sentences.en: Into this yawning vortex of doom.
sentences.zh: 钻进了那个深不见底的厄运漩涡。

sentences.en: Which means, she entered the secret, infinite maze of the inside of our very old house.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，它进入了我们那栋老房子内部秘密且无限的迷宫中。

sentences.en: Now, Mango was a fat little golden floof ball.
sentences.zh: 芒果是一只胖乎乎的小金丝熊。

sentences.en: Not the kind of creature who would survive long without fresh water and food.
sentences.zh: 它不是那种没有新鲜水和食物就能活很久的生物。

sentences.en: We looked everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我们到处都找遍了。

sentences.en: Occasionally, we thought we heard rustling.
sentences.zh: 偶尔，我们以为听到了沙沙声。

sentences.en: In a closet or under a dresser.
sentences.zh: 在壁橱里或梳妆台下。

sentences.en: And we'd shine our lights in there.
sentences.zh: 我们就会把灯照进去。

sentences.en: Nothing.
sentences.zh: 什么都没有。

sentences.en: 24 hours passed.
sentences.zh: 24小时过去了。

sentences.en: 48 hours passed.
sentences.zh: 48小时过去了。

sentences.en: We tried to go on with our normal routines.
sentences.zh: 我们试着继续正常的日常生活。

sentences.en: But we all felt sad and on edge.
sentences.zh: 但我们都感到难过且焦虑。

sentences.en: It was like the whole house had a toothache.
sentences.zh: 就像整个房子都牙疼一样。

sentences.en: Finally, on the third day, we gave up.
sentences.zh: 终于，在第三天，我们放弃了。

sentences.en: We just had to swallow hard and accept the fact that our sweet little Mango,
sentences.zh: 我们只能强忍悲痛，接受这个事实：我们可爱的小芒果，

sentences.en: who'd been our daughter's 16th birthday present, who used to nibble fresh raspberries right out of our fingers, sweet little Mango had met her maker somewhere deep in the walls.
sentences.zh: 那个作为女儿16岁生日礼物、曾经从我们指尖啃食新鲜覆盆子的小芒果，已经在那深墙之内见上帝去了。

sentences.en: And someday there'd be a terrible smell, or some home improvement project would uncover her tiny tragic skeleton.
sentences.zh: 也许有一天会传出可怕的臭味，或者某个房屋翻新项目会发现它那微小而悲剧的骨架。

sentences.en: However, when I say that we gave up on Mango, I should actually say that the humans in our house gave up on her.
sentences.zh: 然而，当我说我们放弃寻找芒果时，其实应该说是我们家的人类放弃了它。

sentences.en: Because late on that third night, when the rest of us were all past hope, a different golden, floofy creature came to the rescue.
sentences.zh: 因为在第三天深夜，当我们其余的人都已绝望时，另一只金灿灿、毛茸茸的生物前来救援了。

sentences.en: Our dog, Walnut.
sentences.zh: 我们的狗，核桃。

sentences.en: Walnut is a completely ridiculous creature.
sentences.zh: 核桃是一个完全荒谬的生物。

sentences.en: A purebred, long-haired, miniature dachshund, with thick, creamy fur like vanilla pudding, and a tail so fancy it should probably be on a tropical fish.
sentences.zh: 一只纯种长毛迷你腊肠犬，有着像香草布丁一样浓密奶油色的皮毛，尾巴漂亮得简直应该长在热带鱼身上。

sentences.en: He's spoiled and lazy, and he spends most of his time staring lovingly into my eyes or napping in sunbeaMs.
sentences.zh: 它被宠坏了，又懒，大部分时间都在深情地盯着我的眼睛看，或者在阳光下打盹。

sentences.en: But during the Mango crisis, while all the humans were busy grieving,
sentences.zh: 但在“芒果危机”期间，当所有人类都在忙着悲伤时，

sentences.en: Walnut suddenly took a break from his napping and became obsessed with a small patch of our living room wall.
sentences.zh: 核桃突然停止了打盹，开始对客厅墙壁的一小块区域着了迷。

sentences.en: He just stood there, staring at it, pointing his long, wiener dog snout and wiggling his nose.
sentences.zh: 它就站在那儿，盯着墙，用它那长长的腊肠犬鼻子指着，还不停地抽动着鼻子。

sentences.en: At first, we ignored him, because, to be honest,
sentences.zh: 起初，我们没理它，因为说实话，

sentences.en: Walnut's nose is probably too powerful for his own good, so he ends up fixated on the tiniest things.
sentences.zh: 核桃的鼻子灵敏得过头了，所以它总会盯着最微小的东西看。

sentences.en: But he kept at it for hours.
sentences.zh: 但它坚持了好几个小时。

sentences.en: He looked at the wall from one side, then from the other side, he cocked his head and made little snorting noises, until finally we got the hint.
sentences.zh: 它从一边看墙，又从另一边看，它歪着头，发出轻微的哼哼声，直到最后我们领会了它的意思。

sentences.en: I took out my tools and disassembled this ancient set of sliding doors in the wall to expose a dark cave.
sentences.zh: 我拿出工具，拆开了墙上那套古老的推拉门，露出了一个黑暗的洞穴。

sentences.en: We put an open peanut butter jar on the floor as bait, and we all held our breath.
sentences.zh: 我们在地板上放了一个打开的花生酱罐子作为诱饵，然后我们都屏住了呼吸。

sentences.en: A few minutes later,
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，

sentences.en: out staggered Mango.
sentences.zh: 芒果摇摇晃晃地走了出来。

sentences.en: She was filthy, covered with the grime of the centuries, probably starving and dehydrated, but she was alive.
sentences.zh: 它脏兮兮的，沾满了几个世纪的尘垢，可能又饿又脱水，但它还活着。

sentences.en: She looked like she'd climbed out of her own grave, which basically she had.
sentences.zh: 它看起来就像是从自己的坟墓里爬出来一样，事实上也确实如此。

sentences.en: We picked her up and dusted her off and put her back in her cage.
sentences.zh: 我们抱起它，拍掉身上的灰尘，把它放回了笼子里。

sentences.en: And we all showered Walnut with extra love and praise and snuggles and treats.
sentences.zh: 我们都给了核桃额外的爱、赞美、拥抱和零食。

sentences.en: And then he went back to sleep.
sentences.zh: 然后它又回去睡觉了。

sentences.en: We humans tend to think of ourselves as superior, with our pants and our phones and our skyscrapers.
sentences.zh: 我们人类往往认为自己高人一等，穿着裤子，拿着手机，住着摩天大楼。

sentences.en: But I believe, I have always believed, that animals are basically magic.
sentences.zh: 但我相信，我一直相信，动物本质上就是魔法。

sentences.en: These creatures that are so obviously not us, but that exist right alongside us, sleeping in our beds, munching grass on the side of the road, rattling their tails, fearing us,
sentences.zh: 这些生物显然与我们不同，但却与我们并肩存在，睡在我们的床上，在路边啃草，摇着尾巴，畏惧我们，

sentences.en: loving us, biting us, They enter worlds we never see.
sentences.zh: 爱着我们，咬着我们，它们进入了我们从未见过的世界。

sentences.en: They sense things we can't detect.
sentences.zh: 它们能感知到我们无法察觉的事物。

sentences.en: Like how Walnut, just by being Walnut, rescued Mango.
sentences.zh: 就像核桃，仅仅因为它是核桃，就救了芒果。

sentences.en: In his lazy, snuffly way, he performed a resurrection.
sentences.zh: 它用那懒洋洋、嗅来嗅去的方式，完成了一次复活。

sentences.en: In fact,
sentences.zh: 事实上，

sentences.en: Walnut himself came into our lives as a sort of resurrection.
sentences.zh: 核桃自己来到我们的生活中，也是一种复活。

sentences.en: He was our second wiener dog, a very deliberate replacement of our first, whose name was Moby.
sentences.zh: 它是我们的第二只腊肠犬，是我们第一只狗的刻意替代，那只狗叫莫比。

sentences.en: I'm not going to say too much about Moby here, because to be very honest, I will start weeping so hard, it'll ruin all of this nice audio equipment.
sentences.zh: 我不想在这里多说莫比，因为老实说，我会哭得太厉害，会毁了这些精密的音频设备。

sentences.en: But basically,
sentences.zh: 但基本上，

sentences.en: Moby was the greatest dog of my life, in the most profound, non-human relationship I've ever had.
sentences.zh: 莫比是我生命中最棒的狗，是我经历过最深刻的非人类关系。

sentences.en: I loved him so deeply, that I became a vegetarian.
sentences.zh: 我太爱它了，以至于我成了素食主义者。

sentences.en: My affection for this little dog, radiated out to cover the whole rest of the animal kingdom.
sentences.zh: 我对这只小狗的爱，辐射到了整个动物王国。

sentences.en: And I just thought that he and I would be together forever.
sentences.zh: 我曾以为它和我能永远在一起。

sentences.en: But of course, that didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 但当然，那并没有发生。

sentences.en: When Moby turned 12, he got cancer, and very suddenly died.
sentences.zh: 莫比12岁时得了癌症，非常突然地去世了。

sentences.en: And it was a complete shock.
sentences.zh: 这完全是个打击。

sentences.en: That first night in bed, I reached out for him, just pure muscle memory.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上躺在床上，我伸手去摸它，纯粹是肌肉记忆。

sentences.en: And there was nothing there.
sentences.zh: 但那里什么都没有。

sentences.en: And I broke down sobbing.
sentences.zh: 我崩溃大哭。

sentences.en: At one point, I found myself petting a photograph of his face.
sentences.zh: 有一次，我发现自己在抚摸一张它的照片。

sentences.en: I was also full of rage.
sentences.zh: 我也充满了愤怒。

sentences.en: I wanted to burn down the universe.
sentences.zh: 我想烧毁整个宇宙。

sentences.en: I either wanted Moby back, which I knew was impossible.
sentences.zh: 我要么想要莫比回来，但我知道那是不可能的。

sentences.en: Or I wanted nothing.
sentences.zh: 要么我什么都不要。

sentences.en: No dog ever again.
sentences.zh: 再也不要养狗了。

sentences.en: Because life seemed to be some kind of scam.
sentences.zh: 因为生活似乎是一场骗局。

sentences.en: A little shell game, in which every living thing secretly carried the pain of its own loss.
sentences.zh: 一个小小的戏法，每一个生命都在秘密地承受着失去的痛苦。

sentences.en: And I was determined never to fall for it again.
sentences.zh: 我下定决心再也不要上当了。

sentences.en: This is when my wife, Sarah, went out and brought home Walnut.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，我的妻子莎拉带回了核桃。

sentences.en: He was from the same breeder as Moby.
sentences.zh: 它和莫比来自同一个饲养员。

sentences.en: And in fact, the same bloodline.
sentences.zh: 事实上，还是同一个血统。

sentences.en: A descendant of Moby's father's brother's cousin, or something.
sentences.zh: 是莫比父亲的兄弟的表亲的后代，之类的。

sentences.en: And Walnut was outrageously cute.
sentences.zh: 核桃可爱得过分。

sentences.en: Big-eyed, fuzzy, clumsy.
sentences.zh: 大眼睛，毛茸茸，笨手笨脚。

sentences.en: Strangers gasped when they saw him in the street.
sentences.zh: 陌生人在街上看到它都会惊叹。

sentences.en: Friends threatened to steal him.
sentences.zh: 朋友们威胁说要偷走它。

sentences.en: The rest of my family needed zero seconds to love Walnut completely.
sentences.zh: 我的家人没花一秒钟就完全爱上了核桃。

sentences.en: But he was not Moby.
sentences.zh: 但它不是莫比。

sentences.en: He was a different color, with long fur instead of short.
sentences.zh: 它的颜色不同，毛发是长的而不是短的。

sentences.en: He didn't cuddle in bed like Moby, didn't walk on his leash like Moby.
sentences.zh: 它不像莫比那样在床上依偎，也不像莫比那样乖乖走牵引绳。

sentences.en: He didn't make little huffing noises while he mashed his forehead into my cheSt.
sentences.zh: 它不会在把额头抵在我胸口时发出那种小小的哼哼声。

sentences.en: Also, Walnut barked at everything.
sentences.zh: 而且，核桃对什么都叫。

sentences.en: And so, for a long time, I did not love him.
sentences.zh: 所以，很长一段时间里，我并不爱它。

sentences.en: But, day by day,
sentences.zh: 但是，日复一日，

sentences.en: Walnut wore down my defenses.
sentences.zh: 核桃瓦解了我的防线。

sentences.en: He molded himself to my habits, and I molded myself to his.
sentences.zh: 它适应了我的习惯，我也适应了它的。

sentences.en: And eventually, I accepted him.
sentences.zh: 最终，我接受了它。

sentences.en: Then, I started to love him.
sentences.zh: 然后，我开始爱它。

sentences.en: And today, it actually hurts me to say this, but, I think I love Walnut as deeply as I loved Moby.
sentences.zh: 今天，说出这句话让我感到心痛，但我认为我爱核桃的程度，和我爱莫比一样深。

sentences.en: Differently, but as much.
sentences.zh: 方式不同，但程度一样。

sentences.en: Which means that I have fallen, yet again, like a total sucker for the stupid trick of life.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，我又一次像个彻头彻尾的傻瓜一样，掉进了生活这个愚蠢的陷阱里。

sentences.en: And, inevitably, terrible pain is on its way.
sentences.zh: 而且，不可避免地，可怕的痛苦正在路上。

sentences.en: Because Walnut just had a birthday.
sentences.zh: 因为核桃刚过生日。

sentences.en: He turned 12.
sentences.zh: 它12岁了。

sentences.en: The age Moby was when he died.
sentences.zh: 莫比去世时的年纪。

sentences.en: The hair on his face has turned white.
sentences.zh: 它脸上的毛已经变白了。

sentences.en: But the hair on my face has turned white too.
sentences.zh: 但我脸上的毛也变白了。

sentences.en: I'm no longer soft and unsuspecting and naive.
sentences.zh: 我不再是那个柔软、毫无防备、天真的人了。

sentences.en: And not just because of Moby.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是因为莫比。

sentences.en: A few years ago, out of nowhere, my father got a horrible illness and died.
sentences.zh: 几年前，毫无征兆地，我父亲得了可怕的疾病去世了。

sentences.en: Right before the global pandemic that killed millions of other fathers and mothers and sisters and brothers.
sentences.zh: 就在那场夺走数百万其他父亲、母亲、姐妹和兄弟生命的全球大流行之前。

sentences.en: Every month now, there seems to be some new, terrifying report about the decline of the whole planet.
sentences.zh: 现在每个月，似乎都有关于整个地球衰落的新的、可怕的报道。

sentences.en: And so, every morning, as I drink my coffee, I run my fingers through Walnut's luscious fur and I think about the fact that he will soon be gone.
sentences.zh: 所以，每天早上，当我喝咖啡时，我用手指梳理着核桃那浓密的皮毛，想到它很快就会离去的事实。

sentences.en: And then, I think about the fact that I too will be gone.
sentences.zh: 然后，我想到我也终将离去的事实。

sentences.en: As will all the other living things on this planet that I've loved and admired, they'll also be gone.
sentences.zh: 正如地球上所有我爱过、钦佩过的其他生命一样，它们也终将离去。

sentences.en: Because we will all eventually slip into that great cosmic hole in the floor.
sentences.zh: 因为我们最终都会滑入那个巨大的宇宙地板洞中。

sentences.en: And there will be no Walnut to rescue us.
sentences.zh: 而且再也不会有核桃来拯救我们了。

sentences.en: And I have no idea what to do about that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: Except,
sentences.zh: 除了，

sentences.en: pet my dog.
sentences.zh: 摸摸我的狗。

sentences.en: Which feels very anchoring.
sentences.zh: 这让我感到非常踏实。

sentences.en: The truth is, we are all animals.
sentences.zh: 事实是，我们都是动物。

sentences.en: We are born, we grow up, we grow hair, we age.
sentences.zh: 我们出生，成长，长出毛发，变老。

sentences.en: Some of us produce other animals.
sentences.zh: 我们中的一些人会繁衍后代。

sentences.en: And they are born.
sentences.zh: 他们出生。

sentences.en: They grow up.
sentences.zh: 他们成长。

sentences.en: They watch us lose our hair.
sentences.zh: 他们看着我们脱发。

sentences.en: Eventually, we all die.
sentences.zh: 最终，我们都会死去。

sentences.en: And we do all of this surrounded by millions of other creatures, human and non-human, who are each doing their version of the same thing.
sentences.zh: 我们所做的一切，都被数以百万计的其他生物所包围，无论是人类还是非人类，他们每个人都在以自己的方式经历着同样的过程。

sentences.en: That trajectory is set.
sentences.zh: 这个轨迹是注定的。

sentences.en: Nothing we can do about it.
sentences.zh: 我们对此无能为力。

sentences.en: But instead of just feeling sad or trying to burn down the universe,
sentences.zh: 但与其仅仅感到悲伤或试图毁灭宇宙，

sentences.en: I am choosing a different path.
sentences.zh: 我选择了一条不同的道路。

sentences.en: I've decided to go out into the world to have a series of encounters with other creatures.
sentences.zh: 我决定走进这个世界，与其他的生物进行一系列的邂逅。

sentences.en: Animals who do not live in my house.
sentences.zh: 那些不住在我家里的动物。

sentences.en: Not to claim them or tame them, but to do something much simpler.
sentences.zh: 不是为了占有或驯服它们，而是为了做一件更简单的事情。

sentences.en: To just be near them.
sentences.zh: 只是待在它们身边。

sentences.en: To look into their eyes and see what I can see.
sentences.zh: 注视它们的眼睛，看看我能从中看到什么。

sentences.en: Right there.
sentences.zh: 就在那里。

sentences.en: Right there.
sentences.zh: 就在那里。

sentences.en: They're all over.
sentences.zh: 它们到处都是。

sentences.en: While we're all still here to see it.
sentences.zh: 趁我们都还在，还能亲眼见证。

sentences.en: They're everywhere.
sentences.zh: 它们无处不在。

sentences.en: I need that one.
sentences.zh: 我需要那一只。

sentences.en: Wait, what happens if I put my fingers in that bottom cage?
sentences.zh: 等等，如果我把手指伸进那个底部的笼子里会发生什么？

sentences.en: He will probably bite you.
sentences.zh: 它可能会咬你。

sentences.en: To the bone.
sentences.zh: 咬到骨头。

sentences.en: To the bone?
sentences.zh: 咬到骨头？

sentences.en: All right, we gotta lose Barrett.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们得甩掉巴雷特。

sentences.en: Did somebody get it up?
sentences.zh: 有人把它弄上来了吗？

sentences.en: We're really close to my head.
sentences.zh: 离我的头真的很近。

sentences.en: Is that your blood or its blood?
sentences.zh: 那是你的血还是它的血？

sentences.en: I think it's mine.
sentences.zh: 我想是我的。

sentences.en: I guess what I'm asking is for you to improvise a song about rescuing pufflings.
sentences.zh: 我想我的要求是，请你即兴创作一首关于营救海鹦幼雏的歌。

sentences.en: Searching down in the darkness below for the puffets of my soul.
sentences.zh: 在下方的黑暗中寻找我灵魂的海鹦。

sentences.en: Something like that.
sentences.zh: 差不多就是这样。

sentences.en: From the New York Times,
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，

sentences.en: I'm Sam Anderson.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·安德森。

sentences.en: This is Animal.
sentences.zh: 这是《动物》。

sentences.en: Also, I've still not fixed the hole in the floor.
sentences.zh: 另外，我还没修好地板上的那个洞。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Anderson.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·安德森。
